briefing.text:
## Who and why
- Dana Ruiz, platform lead, wants to cut p99 latency on the shipment API (call brief, 4 Nov)
## Deals
- Platform expansion, 180k, stage Evaluate, close 15 Dec (opportunity: Platform expansion)
## Open issues
- Rate limits returned 429 under burst load; fixed in Beacon 2.3 (issue #412, https://tracker.example.com/issues/412)
## Competition
- Comparing against an open source proxy they run today (call brief, 4 Nov)

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making the time today.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Happy to. I have about thirty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Great. Last time we talked about the shipment API.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Right, and finance asked me about the expansion budget again.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Understood, we can walk through the numbers later.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Sure. The bigger problem is that we keep seeing 429s at peak.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Is that during the morning dispatch burst?

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Yes, every morning around seven, for about ten minutes.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: And the clients retry right away?

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: They do, which makes it worse.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Okay. Tell me about what you run today in front of the API.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: It is the open source proxy, what we run today has been fine until now.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: How many instances?

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Six, across two regions.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: And latency at p99 right now?

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Around four hundred milliseconds, we want it under two hundred.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: That is a reasonable target with local caching.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: We tried caching, it helped a little.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: We could set up a benchmark during the pilot.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: That would help me make the case internally.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: I will send a plan for the benchmark.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Thanks. Anything else from your side?

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Just the timeline for the decision.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: We want to decide before the end of the year.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Perfect, talk soon.

bullets.quote: Platform expansion, 180k, stage Evaluate, close 15 Dec
Rate limits returned 429 under burst load; fixed in Beacon 2.3

bullets.text: They run an open source proxy today
bullets.quote: they evaluated three vendors last spring

bullets.text: Consider relating the latency discussion to the earlier benchmark results from the pilot phase last quarter
